item.title: IndyCar teams assemble for Sebring test
item.description: 10 of last year's 11 full-time IndyCar teams have headed down to Florida to test at Sebring International Raceway.

item.title: Delaware Life back with Ericsson for 2026
item.description: Delaware Life will be the primary sponsor of Marcus Ericsson's No. 28 Andretti Global Honda in the 2026 IndyCar Series.

item.title: 'Early days' but Brown expecting strong title defense from McLaren
item.description: Zak Brown is expecting McLaren to be strong once again, but he admits it may be too early to draw conclusions.

He will return to the seat of the No. 6 RFK Racing Ford Mustang this weekend for the season-opening...

item.title: Dale Coyne Racing signs Pappas to its engineering team
item.description: Legendary engineer Bill Pappas is back in the IndyCar paddock with Dale Coyne Racing.

item.title: Viry-Chatillon mayor hits out at Renault amid Alpine WEC exit speculation
item.description: The mayor of Viry-Chatillon, where the development of the A424 LMDh is carried out, has said Renault is "reneging on its commitments" to the area.

item.title: Cadillac F1 launches 2026 livery with Super Bowl ad
item.description: Cadillac Formula 1 Team revealed the livery for its inaugural campaign in the highest-profile way possible, via a television commercial in the closing stages of Super Bowl LX.
